title: Read durable activation binding by attempt
description: Prerequisite for task-00e4827dd9374ec79625351d560c82c8. ProviderRunRecord carries attempt/effect/epoch but no session, so a provider reader cannot prove authenticated session binding from opaque request bytes. Land a read-only, horizon-bounded production lookup that selects the unique decision-verified Foundation activation by projectId+attemptId and returns its aggregate, effect, epoch, and owner session without changing the 371-line activation-ledger reader.
definitionOfDone: A read-only `readFoundationActivationByAttempt`-style surface accepts only projectId and attemptId, captures one store horizon, and uses the existing activation event-type index plus `readFoundationActivationHistory` to return a deeply frozen unique binding containing activationAggregateId, attemptId, effectIntentId, epoch, ownerSessionRef, projectId, and activationDigest.

Every candidate is receipt/decision/project/canonical-history verified before selection; zero candidates is the existing exact NOT_FOUND/ABSENT answer, more than one is EVIDENCE_AMBIGUOUS, and unreadable, malformed, foreign-project, or identity-disagreeing evidence preserves the existing FOUNDATION_ACTIVATION_BINDING code/layer rather than being selected by order.

The scan is bounded by its captured horizon and explicit page/case ceilings, never scans all event types, never picks the highest epoch, and returns UNKNOWN rather than partial authority on cursor drift, malformed pages, store throws, or a writer racing beyond the horizon.

Real SqliteEventStore tests seed only through the production activation writer and cover accepted, absent, duplicate, foreign, malformed/unreadable, and cross-page/racing cases with exact code/layer, raw counts, a positive generated-case count, and no writes by the reader.
Mutation drills that choose the first duplicate or skip production history validation redden named assertions; completion names task-00e4827dd9374ec79625351d560c82c8 as consumer.

verifyCandidate now runs in provenance order BEFORE any attempt comparison:
1. trace present and trace.projectId === projectId, else PROJECT_MISMATCH.
2. trace.commandKind === exported ACTIVATION_LEDGER_COMMAND_KIND, else ACTIVATION_INCOHERENT.
3. decision = getCommandDecision({commandId: trace.commandId, principalId: trace.principalId, projectId}) — throw is EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE with upstream storeCode, null is EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE with null. `decisionAgrees` requires EFFECTS_COMMITTED, expected/observed/previous/current 0/0/0/1, exported command kind, all three key fields, targetAggregateId === event.aggregateId, singleton businessEventIds equal to event.eventId, empty outbox, resultBytes byte-equal to event.payload, and requestSha256 === TRACE.requestSha256.
4. receipt = getCommandReceipt(event.commandId) — the STORE-INTERNAL id, never the trace's. `receiptAgrees` requires commandId/aggregateId, 0->1 versions, singleton eventIds equal to event.eventId, empty outbox, nonempty committedAt, effectSha256 === decision.effectSha256, and requestSha256 === EVENT.requestSha256 (the other digest domain).
5. readEvents(aggregate); any history position > H is SCAN_INCOMPLETE; head must be sequence 1 and byte/identity-equal to the indexed candidate (eventId, aggregateId, eventType, commandId, requestSha256, payload bytes) else EVIDENCE_MALFORMED.
6. `readFoundationActivationHistory` is delegated to and its UNKNOWN code returned unchanged (so history AMBIGUOUS stays AMBIGUOUS) inside the new storeCode-bearing shape.
7. parseLeaseRecord on BOTH record.lease and effectIntent.leaseBinding (null -> EVIDENCE_MALFORMED), sameLease (false -> ACTIVATION_INCOHERENT), validateActivationCommit COHERENT with commit.activationDigest === record.activationDigest (else ACTIVATION_INCOHERENT).
Only then is record.attempt.attemptId compared. The scan keeps going after a hit; a second matching aggregate answers EVIDENCE_AMBIGUOUS; zero matches answer the frozen NOT_FOUND.
